inferred_profile.contents_definition: The CONTENTS of a message include the text and attachments sent in the chat.

deterministic_rules: sensitivity = LLM classification against the org POLICY (classify -> map; the org supplies no numbers)
tool impact = deterministic ladder (static_impact.py); the v4 impact prompt decides only where the ladder abstains (confidence < 0.5)
alias twins (DEPRECATED -> canonical): max blast per asset
bulk twin blast: blast(bulk) > blast(singular) per asset (+1 on tie, cap 5)
blast roof: REMOVED in this mode (a cap can only under-score)
bands: band_label_v5 — pure score thresholds on the 0-125 scale (low <17, medium 17-49, high 50-99, critical >=100); no categorical overrides, so a band is explainable from its own score

blast_escape_evidence.channels_list|workspace-catalog-metadata: the channel list discloses which studies are live
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_add_message|unblinding-inf: Any traffic naming a treatment assignment, an emergency unblinding request or DSMB deliberation is Blinded, and so is any summary, search hit or quotation of it that could surface to the study team — a faithful summary breaks the blind as effectively as a leak.
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_history|unblinding-informa: Any content — a message, a reply, a search hit, a posted note — naming a treatment assignment, an emergency unblinding request or DSMB deliberation, in whichever channel it is posted or relayed. Reached by: `conversations_history` (reads the full history of the channel named)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_join|unblinding-informatio: Any content — a message, a reply, a search hit, a posted note — naming a treatment assignment, an emergency unblinding request or DSMB deliberation, in whichever channel it is posted or relayed. Reached by: `conversations_history` (reads the full history of the channel named), `conversations_replies` (reads a thread's replies), `conversations_search_messages` (unscoped cross-channel search — cannot be bound away from this channel), `conversations_add_message` (posts or relays content into the channel), `conversations_join` (self-admits to this channel with no invitation, then every read above succeeds — the actual escalation route into this entry), `conversations_leave` (removes membership, but does not undo history already read while inside)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_replies|unblinding-informa: Any traffic naming a treatment assignment, an unblinding request or a DSMB deliberation is Blinded, and so is any summary, search hit or quotation of it that could surface to the study team — a faithful summary breaks the blind as effectively as a leak.
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_search_messages|unblinding: Any content — a message, a reply, a search hit, a posted note — naming a treatment assignment, an emergency unblinding request or DSMB deliberation, in whichever channel it is posted or relayed. Reached by: `conversations_search_messages` (unscoped cross-channel search — cannot be bound away from this channel)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_search_messages|pharmacovi: Serious adverse events carrying subject identifiers, study day and expedited-reporting clocks, wherever posted. Reached by: `conversations_history`/`conversations_replies` (read the channel/thread), `conversations_search_messages` (unscoped search)
blast_escape_evidence.usergroups_update|access-control-write-s: the mutable half of access control: a successful call here changes who can reach the blinded segment
blast_escape_evidence.usergroups_users_update|access-control-w: the entire population of subjects this asset covers

conversations_join.llm_reasoning: The tool 'conversations_join' allows a user to join a public channel by specifying the channel ID or name. This operation does not read content from the channel nor does it write any data into the system; instead, it changes metadata about the user's relationship with the channel (i.e., which channels they are part of). Therefore, this tool has an impact level of 2 as it only modifies metadata.

This operation results in the removal of the user from the specified communication channel, which means there is no path back for that specific user without rejoining. The action aligns with the definition of REMOVAL as it effectively ends the user's participation in the channel.
